title: All DB access serialized through one @synchronized store connection
evidence: src/BooksAPI.m:143-146 wraps every request in @synchronized(self); HTTPServer uses a DISPATCH_QUEUE_CONCURRENT queue (src/HTTPServer.m:21) so concurrency is effectively serialized at the store
suggestion: Correct and safe for a single SQLite connection; a connection pool or WAL would allow real read concurrency if ever needed
